audit: Provided Overture M1 record_id version-token parser and length support audit

method.input: Only challenge-provided Overture roads fields class, sources, and geometry, plus the official provided ACS tract polygons needed for clipping; no OSM history or outside data.
method.eligible_length: Road lines in the registered classes clipped to official scored tract polygons, then restricted for parsing denominators to segments with an OpenStreetMap source membership. Report total class road length and source coverage separately.
method.version_parser: The independently unit-tested parser fullmatches the untrimmed stringified OSM sources.record_id against ^w\d+@(\d+)$ case-insensitively and returns the captured integer only on full match; this mirrors the existing M1 parser. Non-OSM IDs are not parsed.
method.segment_consistency: The acceptance criterion is conservative: a segment is unambiguous only when it has at least one nonempty OSM record_id, every nonempty OSM ID fullmatches the exact M1 parser, and all parsed tokens collapse to one distinct integer version. M1 itself deterministically averages multiple parsed versions, but that aggregation does not count as a unique unambiguous segment version for this audit. The more permissive any-valid and all-token-valid support fractions are reported separately.
method.geometry: Transform provided road and official tract geometries from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:5070, intersect, and weight each source segment by the sum of its clipped length inside official tracts.
method.redaction: No raw record_id values are written. Malformed and multiple-version examples are reported only as character-shape patterns with digits mapped to # and letters mapped to A.
method.hashing: SHA-256 digests cover class/source record_id/WKB input streams, clipped segment summaries, official GEOID/region ordering, and canonical audit metrics.
method.interpretation_limit: Parser support is data-quality evidence only; it does not validate M1's association with the hidden target, accuracy, causality, or estimator promotion.

parse_consistency_gate.eligible_length_definition: all clipped named and tertiary road length with at least one OpenStreetMap source membership, including segments without a nonempty record_id
parse_consistency_gate.numerator: clipped length on OSM-sourced segments with at least one nonempty record_id, every nonempty OSM ID fullmatching the exact M1 way-version parser, and exactly one distinct parsed integer version. Missing, nonmatching, or multiple distinct versions are excluded from this conservative unambiguous-support gate.

version_distribution_by_integer.weighting_note: Token count counts individual OSM source record_id values; clipped length is repeated once for each matching record token on a segment and is therefore intentionally non-additive when a segment has multiple tokens.
